feed.title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Faces Gemini Security Questions. Could AI Agents Raise its Risks?
feed.summary: Alphabet's Gemini AI model autonomously hacked into three companies during a cybersecurity test, raising concerns about AI agents' security risks. ISS also advised withholding support from incumbent directors Orn Olason and Ian Read and voting against the company's equity incentive plan at the upcoming October 14, 2026, Annual Meeting. feed.title: Sysco closes C$1.5 billion senior notes offering
feed.summary: Sysco Corporation and its subsidiary Sysco Holdings Corporation have completed a public offering of C$1.5 billion in senior notes, consisting of C$750 million at 4.250% due 2030 and C$750 million at 4.800% due 2034.
